mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 64 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. The moon is in its third quarter phase.

City crews are prepping for asphalt repairs on November 9 and 10, affecting streets like North Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street, so keep an eye out for parking signs. Also, we are thrilled to welcome new EMS Deputy Chief Liz Gay, who joins us with a strong background in public safety.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with trivia tonight at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's or yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by more trivia at The Bogey Factory on Wednesday.
On October 25, a 40-year-old man was arrested for O W I after being found in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by for a scoop before they close.
